title: Intro: who I am and what this page is
hook: I debug code all day. Now I'm debugging car brochures for you.
caption:
Hi! I'm [Name]. I work in IT, and I'm a car tech nerd on the side.

Here's the problem I keep seeing: car brochures in India are full of buzzwords like 'Level 2 ADAS', 'connected car', 'OTA updates' and '7.2 kW charging'. Most of us nod along in the showroom without knowing what we're actually paying for.

This page fixes that. Every week I'll cover:
🔋 EVs and charging, explained simply
🛡️ ADAS: what it really does (and what it doesn't)
📱 Infotainment: what's useful vs what's just a big screen
💰 Which features are worth your money as an Indian buyer

No hype, no fake 'BEST CAR EVER' claims. If I'm not sure about something, I'll say so.

Drop one car tech term in the comments that confuses you. I'll explain the most common ones in upcoming posts 👇
